item.title: COLLEGE ROUNDUP: Misericordia rallies past Manchester
item.description: Misericordia fell behind by two runs after the top of the first, but answered with three in the bottom of the third and another in the sixth to defeat Manchester University on Monday afternoon at Fort Pierce, Florida, as part of the team’s spring training trip. Vin Proietto had two singles and one RBI for Misericordia. Michael Duda had two hits, including a double, and scored one run. Drew Van Horn had a single and a run. item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Keira Dougherty, Crestwood basketball
item.description: After missing all of last season with an injury, Crestwood guard Keira Dougherty had to watch from the sideline as her team won its first District 2 basketball championship and went on a run to the PIAA Class 5A semifinals. Dougherty did the best she could cheering on her teammates and offering words of encouragement along the way. Cleared to play for her senior season, Dougherty wasted no time getting back in the mix. item.title: Community Spotlight: Mountain Top – March 3, 2026
item.description: Cornerstone Christian Fellowship Church mission trip fundraiser at TGI Fridays: 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Wednesday, March 4. TGI Fridays, 880 Kidder St., Wilkes-Barre. item.title: PA Cyber students celebrate Martin Luther King Jr. Day through service
item.description: PA Cyber students, family members and staff supported their communities through a recent statewide effort to honor Martin Luther King Jr.’s legacy. They donated meals, supplies and their time to various organizations. In Wilkes-Barre, students made scarves, and on Jan. 22 they visited Public Square and a local bus station to distribute the scarves to those in need. Other efforts were held throughout the commonwealth with students helping at food pantries, homeless shelters and children’s program

item.title: SUPPORT GROUPS: March 2026
item.description: Dallas Alzheimer’s Support for Caregivers Group: Meets 10 a.m., first Thursday of the month. St. Paul’s Lutheran Church, 474 Yalick Road, Dallas. Alzheimer’s and dementia support group: First Tuesday of each month, 1:30 to 2:30 p.m. Hosted by Home Instead, LIFE Geisinger and Tiffany Court. Tiffany Court at Kingston, 700 Northampton St., Kingston. Free. Grief Share: 1 to 3 p.m. Wednesdays, Jan. 14 to April 1. Cross Creek Community Church, 370 Carverton Road, Trucksville. Free, open to the public.
